content.user_title: Audit Azure Compliance and Key Vault Expiration
content.value_statement: Azure teams need clear compliance findings before risks become outages. This skill runs scoped audits and turns results into prioritized actions.
actual_capabilities: Run Azure Quick Review scans through Azure MCP tools.
Interpret azqr recommendation, inventory, Advisor, Defender, and policy results.
Audit Key Vault keys, secrets, and certificates for expiration status.
Use Azure Resource Graph patterns for tag, public access, and lock checks.
Map common findings to Azure CLI, Bicep, or portal remediation guidance.
Classify findings by security, reliability, cost, and operations impact.
limitations: Requires Azure authentication and read permissions for the target scope.
Does not deploy resources or apply fixes without separate user action.
Accuracy depends on current Azure inventory and tool response data.
Key Vault checks focus on metadata needed for expiration review.

use_cases.title: Subscription Compliance Review
use_cases.description: Cloud platform teams scan subscriptions and rank findings by risk and impact.

use_cases.title: Key Vault Expiration Audit
use_cases.description: Azure administrators identify expired or soon-expiring keys, secrets, and certificates.

use_cases.title: Governance Remediation Planning
use_cases.description: Security leads convert audit results into clear remediation plans and owners.

prompt_templates.title: Scan One Scope
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit for a known subscription or resource group.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Azure scope for compliance issues. Summarize the top risks and recommended next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Check Key Vault Expiration
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review for credentials and certificates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Key Vault for expired items, items expiring soon, and items without expiration dates.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize azqr Results
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate analysis after a scan completes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the azqr results. Group findings by severity, affected service, and remediation effort.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Remediation Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across compliance, reliability, and operations findings.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a remediation plan for these Azure compliance findings. Include owners, dependencies, validation steps, and follow-up scan criteria.

output_examples.input: Audit my production subscription for compliance issues.
output: Summary of scanned scope, resource count, and scan time.
Prioritized findings grouped by critical, high, medium, and low impact.
Recommended actions with expected risk reduction and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Find Key Vault items that expire in the next 30 days.
output: A count of expired, expiring, missing-expiration, and healthy items.
A short action list for rotation, policy updates, and monitoring.
Notes about permissions, unavailable vaults, or incomplete responses.

output_examples.input: Turn these azqr findings into a remediation plan.
output: A ranked plan by service area, business impact, and effort.
Clear remediation options using portal, Azure CLI, or infrastructure as code.
A verification checklist for the next compliance scan.

best_practices: Limit scans to authorized subscriptions, management groups, or resource groups.
Review findings with service owners before planning remediation work.
Run follow-up scans after fixes to confirm compliance changes.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad scans without confirming the intended Azure scope.
Do not treat cost findings as security findings without added context.
Do not retrieve Key Vault secret values when metadata is enough.

faq.question: What Azure permissions does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs authentication and read access to the selected Azure scope. Key Vault checks may need data-plane metadata access.

faq.question: Can it fix compliance findings automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides remediation guidance, but fixes require separate user approval and execution.

faq.question: Does it support resource group scans?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow supports subscription, resource group, management group, and service-focused assessments.

faq.question: What reports can it interpret?
faq.answer: It can interpret azqr results, inventory data, Advisor recommendations, Defender findings, and Azure Policy status.

faq.question: Does it expose Key Vault secrets?
faq.answer: The intended workflow reviews expiration metadata. Users should avoid retrieving secret values during audits.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
